name: Hot Lead - Initial Contact
subject: Great meeting you, {{name}}!
body:
Dear {{name}},

It was wonderful meeting you at the conference! I could sense your keen interest in our investment solutions.

At FinIdeas, we specialize in helping professionals like you maximize their investment returns with personalized strategies.

I'd love to schedule a quick call to discuss how we can help you achieve your financial goals.

Looking forward to connecting soon!

Best regards,
FinIdeas Team

name: Hot Lead - Meeting Invite
subject: Your Exclusive Consultation - {{name}}
body:

name: Warm Lead - Initial Contact
subject: Nice connecting with you, {{name}}
body:
Dear {{name}},

Thank you for stopping by our stall at the conference!

At FinIdeas, we offer a range of investment solutions tailored to different risk appetites and financial goals.

I'd be happy to share more information about our services. Would you be interested in a brief call?

Feel free to reply to this email with your preferred time.

name: Warm Lead - Follow Up
subject: Following up - FinIdeas Investment Solutions
body:
Dear {{name}},

I hope this email finds you well!

I wanted to follow up on our conversation at the conference. Have you had a chance to think about your investment goals?

We have some exciting opportunities that might interest you. I'd love to share more details.

Let me know if you'd like to schedule a quick call.

body:
